sections.heading: Quoted literals
sections.markdown:
`"..."` / `r"..."`: escaped / raw strings (both interpolate `${...}`)

`b"..."` / `br"..."`: escaped / raw `[u8; L]`

`c"..."` / `cr"..."`: escaped / raw `[u8; L+1]` with appended NUL

One quote is inline, two quotes are empty, and `Q >= 3` is block form. A block opener is followed immediately by a newline and its exact-count closer is alone on a line.

sections.heading: Value and concurrency boundary contracts
bullets: `const` fixes a binding and its value-semantic components; class and synchronized objects retain identity and are not deeply frozen
Array assignment, saved READ parameters, and returns preserve logical copies without explicit copy/move or unique backing
go arguments and captures must be Sendable; ordinary outer var captures are forbidden even for reads
`Channel<T>` requires copyable, storable, Sendable payloads; ref and Slice/MutSlice loans cannot cross go boundaries
Consuming parameters and receivers are for noncopyable resources; the declaration decides transfer and an explicit move marker is optional
Type-position const T, the public copy(array) spelling, and standalone move for copyable values are outside the frozen subset
These target contracts do not certify complete new-XIR go, Task, resource, or synchronization support; declaration-family qualification remains required

sections.heading: Important notes
bullets: `print()` outputs with newline; there is no `println`
arrow function parameter types may be inferred only when the context is known
`const ch = Channel<T>(n)` creates a stable named channel handle; `Channel<T>` is used in type position
field increment such as `this.x++` is not supported; assign explicitly
same-quote strings are allowed inside `${...}` interpolation
